title: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(3)
desc: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(3)

paragraphs.en: In 1987, Arlene Kaplan Daniels, in an essay titled Invisible Work, developed a critique of the general understanding of work that placed this activity in a special sphere, set apart from the rest of life.
paragraphs.zh: 1987年，阿琳·卡普兰·丹尼尔斯在一篇题为《无形劳动》的文章中，对人们对工作的普遍理解提出了批评；这种普遍理解将劳动置于一个特殊的领域，与生活的其他方面隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: Developing her analysis from earlier, feminist examinations of how domestic labour was gendered, disregarded and devalued, like Silvia Federici's Wages Against Housework, Daniels used the term "invisible work" to refer to tasks that are done not only out of sight, but also out of mind.
paragraphs.zh: 丹尼尔斯借鉴早期女权主义者对家务劳动如何被赋予性别特征、被忽视和被贬低的研究（比如西尔维娅·费代里西的《家务劳动工资》），展开了自己的分析。她用“无形劳动”这一术语来指那些不仅不为人所见，而且不被人关注的任务。

paragraphs.en: These were tasks that simply weren't thought of as work, but as natural activities – what any woman should do voluntarily, happily and without compensation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务根本不被视为劳动，而被当作自然的活动——任何女性都应该自愿、愉快且无偿地去做的事情。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, in Daniels' conception, invisible work had a physical and an emotional component.
paragraphs.zh: 至关重要的是，在丹尼尔斯的概念中，无形劳动包含身体和情感两个方面。

paragraphs.en: Such work included not only the cleaning, cooking and logistics involved in managing a household, but also the ultimate responsibility for the wellbeing of guests as well as other household members.
paragraphs.zh: 这类劳动不仅包括打理家务所需的清洁、烹饪和后勤事务，还包括对客人以及其他家庭成员的幸福安康承担最终责任。

paragraphs.en: The way these duties become framed as "natural" was part of a moral narrative in which women would succeed or fail at being women depending on the emotional reactions of others.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些职责定义为“自然而然”的做法，是道德叙事的一部分，在这种叙事中，女性是否能成功扮演女性角色，取决于他人的情感反应。

paragraphs.en: In this analysis, invisible work kept the social world and the capitalist economy running.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项分析中，无形劳动维持着社会和资本主义经济的运转。

paragraphs.en: Men were only able to work full shifts outside the home because women's invisible work enabled them to do so, and the social role expectations of gender roles for men and women were similarly supported and maintained.
paragraphs.zh: 男性之所以能够在外全职工作，是因为女性的无形劳动使他们得以如此，而且男女性别角色的社会角色期望也同样得到了支持和维持。

paragraphs.en: The asymmetry of the power relations between genders are magnified in this way, as is the economic imbalance.
paragraphs.zh: 通过这种方式，性别之间权力关系的不对称性被放大了，经济失衡也是如此。

paragraphs.en: In many ways, Daniels' argument applies directly to the invisible work imposed on disabled people by an inaccessible world.
paragraphs.zh: 在很多方面，丹尼尔斯的观点直接适用于无障碍环境缺失的世界强加给残疾人的无形劳动。

paragraphs.en: On the face of it, there is a significant difference: the invisible work of women is largely carried out for others, while the invisible work of disabled people is carried out for themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 从表面上看，两者存在一个显著的差异：女性的无形劳动主要是为他人付出的，而残疾人的无形劳动则是为自己付出的。

paragraphs.en: But this distinction is something of an illusion.
paragraphs.zh: 但这种区别在某种程度上是一种错觉。

paragraphs.en: First, disabled people are often women.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，残疾人中常常有女性。

paragraphs.en: And the burdens of invisible work tend to exacerbate or even create impairments and chronic illnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 而且无形劳动的负担往往会加剧甚至导致残疾和慢性病。

paragraphs.en: Second, invisible work that supports a particular way of being in the world is also work that supports a complex network of social relations.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，支持某种特定生活方式的无形劳动，也是支持复杂社会关系网络的劳动。

paragraphs.en: The salient question about disability and invisible work is therefore very similar to the one about invisible work and gender: what would the world look like if it was no longer carried out?
paragraphs.zh: 因此，关于残疾和无形劳动的关键问题与关于无形劳动和性别的问题非常相似：如果不再进行这种无形劳动，世界会是什么样子呢？

paragraphs.en: In my own case, my invisible work supports nearly every aspect of my social being, from my role as spouse and parent to my role as an academic and writer.
paragraphs.zh: 就我自己而言，我那些无形劳动支撑着我社会生活的方方面面，从作为配偶和为人父母的角色，到学者和作家的角色。

paragraphs.en: I could not teach my students nor share the household responsibilities without these efforts; I could not fully be a part of my son's life.
paragraphs.zh: 没有这些付出，我就无法给学生授课，也无法分担家务；我也无法充分参与到我儿子的生活中。

paragraphs.en: At home, my wife and I have done our best to share the invisible work as justly as possible, the standard being that we should both, at the end of the day, be equally tired.
paragraphs.zh: 在家里，我和妻子都尽力尽可能公平地分担那些无形的家务，标准是到一天结束时，我们俩应该同样疲惫。

paragraphs.en: She can lift heavier things than I can; I can take on more of the logistical work of the second shift, remembering and planning for the dentist's appointments and clothes purchases that are the warp and weft of parenthood.
paragraphs.zh: 她比我力气大，能搬更重的东西；我则可以承担更多下班后的后勤工作，记住并安排看牙医的预约、购买衣物等，这些都是为人父母生活中的点点滴滴。

paragraphs.en: Outside our household, things become more complicated, since I am not negotiating or collaborating with a single person, but with the world.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们家之外，事情变得更加复杂了，因为我不是在和某一个人协商或合作，而是在和整个世界打交道。

paragraphs.en: I could withdraw, to an extent.
paragraphs.zh: 在一定程度上，我可以选择退缩。

paragraphs.en: I could resign from my university post and apply for disability payments, but this would not remove the need for me to maintain my existence with the multitude of tasks and errands that bring me into contact with inaccessible stores and venues, with service providers and government agencies.
paragraphs.zh: 我可以辞去大学的工作，申请残疾补贴，但这并不能消除我维持生计所需完成的大量任务和杂事，而这些事会让我不得不与那些不方便进入的商店和场所、服务提供商以及政府机构打交道。

paragraphs.en: The only way to escape this work, short of a utopian remaking of the world, is to stop living.
paragraphs.zh: 除非对世界进行乌托邦式的重塑，否则摆脱这项工作的唯一办法就是停止生存。

paragraphs.en: Disabled people know this.
paragraphs.zh: 残疾人深知这一点。

paragraphs.en: They know that they have the right to access, in principle and in law, but that they must work, continuously, in order to claim this right.
paragraphs.zh: 他们明白，从原则和法律上讲，他们有权获得相应权益，但为了主张这一权利，他们必须持续努力。

paragraphs.en: They know that this is because there are many institutions, and people, that would much prefer a world without disabled people in it.
paragraphs.zh: 他们清楚，这是因为有许多机构和人更希望生活在一个没有残疾人的世界里。

paragraphs.en: Not a world without disabling forces; a world without disabled people.
paragraphs.zh: 不是没有造成残疾因素的世界，而是没有残疾人的世界。

paragraphs.en: And so the invisible work is, at heart, the high cost of living in a disabling world.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，这种无形的付出，本质上是生活在一个存在致残因素世界里的高昂代价。
